FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN tx

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

       COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K

WITH atm_2025 AS (
  SELECT d_br.BR_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.DT_YR = 2025
  GROUP BY d_br.BR_NM
)
SELECT * FROM atm_2025 ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dflt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dflt
    JOIN target_date td ON dflt.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
    WHERE dflt.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

SELECT
  d.CSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE ddt.DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.CSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_last AS (
  SELECT MAX(bus_dt_k) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
  WHERE d.dt_ym = '2023-08'  -- adjust year as needed
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
    JOIN august_last al ON fd.bus_dt_k = al.last_dt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON fd.cust_k = c.cust_k
    WHERE fd.dflt_flg = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH fx_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    d.DT_DT AS business_date,
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    f.MID_RT AS mid_rate

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.DT_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  currency,
  AVG(mid_rate) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM fx_2025
GROUP BY currency
ORDER BY currency;

), m AS (

    f.ACCT_K,

    d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT IN ('2025-06-30', '2025-12-31')
),
  bal_30 AS (
    SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_30
    FROM bal WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  ),
  bal_31 AS (
    SELECT ACCT_K, CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_31

WITH resolved_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    c.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    c.CNTCT_STRTD_AT,
    c.RSLTN_AT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
  WHERE c.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.RSLTN_AT) = 2025
), days_calc AS (
  SELECT
    r.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.RSLTN_AT - r.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) / 86400.0 AS days_to_resolve
  FROM resolved_2025 r
)
SELECT
  d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(dc.days_to_resolve), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolve
FROM days_calc dc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
  ON dc.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY avg_days_to_resolve DESC;
